_doc: Presentation figures of the world view (game/ only, no rule reads them): zoom, camera, day/night, timings and the colours of the marks drawn by code (signs, doors, badges, bars). The look of each thing (greybox colours, heights, kit) lives in its scene in game/visuals/ (docs/protocolos/editar-a-mano.md). GDD 4.15 gives the day/night colours. zoom_levels: only values that keep pixels whole (D2). tint_strength: how far the phase colour pulls from white (1 = the raw colour, too dark for #1A1A40 at night). transition_minutes: game minutes a phase takes to blend in from the previous one.

see_through._doc: Scale B (docs/arte/escala.md): a building, the town hall or a filler house goes see-through (alpha) while the selected person stands behind it and its drawn pixels cover them (WorldView._update_see_through). Only visuals whose Top marker is at least min_height px high (houses and buildings, not yards, stalls or trees). alpha = 1 turns it off.

character._doc: width: the click area of a walker (its height is the Top marker of its scene). outline: the badge's border when it does not work for the player. H4: employees carry a diamond over the head in the colour of the family they work for; gold border (badge_own_border) when it is the player's family.

buildings._doc: Marks of the buildings of state.buildings on the map (by type): sign and door colours. H4: sign_mode = "hover" shows the sign only while the mouse is over the building or it is picked (the houses: the town is not full of signs). The building itself is game/visuals/buildings/<type>.tscn.

services._doc: H3 marks of the market stalls and the contract board on the map: sign colours (the stalls and the board are game/visuals/props/stall_<id>.tscn and board.tscn).

ground_edges._doc: GroundLayer: where a tile of the kind (key) touches one of the listed kinds, its edge art (assets/art/tiles/<kind>_edge_<side>.png) is drawn on that side: the river's bank, the bridge's curb over the water. Remove a kind to drop its edges.

ground_corners._doc: GroundLayer: on a tile of a listed kind whose two neighbours on sides that meet at a corner are both of the key kind (a diagonal street drawn as a stair of tiles), a triangle of the key kind is painted over that corner, `fill` of the way along its two sides, so the stair reads as one smooth ribbon. Purely visual. Remove a kind (or the block) to drop it.

map_border._doc: A ring of tiles around the map, outside the playable grid and purely visual (GroundLayer + WorldView._add_border_trees): `ground` everywhere except the kinds of `extend` that reach the map's edge (they carry on outwards: streets, the river); from `fade_from` tiles out it darkens towards `fade_to` (the background). Trees of `trees` (scene ids of game/visuals/props/, weights = repeat) from `tree_from` tiles out, with a chance per tile growing from tree_density[0] to tree_density[1] at the outer edge. tiles = 0 removes the border.

building_variants._doc: Building types with several looks: type -> scene ids of game/visuals/buildings/ (one per building, picked by its origin tile, the same every game; weights = repeat). Without an entry, the scene named like the type. Rules never read this (the type stays the same).

seasonal_tiles._doc: Tile kinds whose ground changes with the season (GroundLayer.set_season, from the clock): assets/art/tiles/<kind>_<spring|summer|autumn|winter>.png, else <kind>.png. field: sprouts, green rows, golden wheat, bare earth. Empty kinds = no change.

prop_variants._doc: Map props with several looks: tile kind -> scene ids of game/visuals/props/ (one per tile, picked by the tile, the same every game; weights = repeat an id). Without an entry, the scene named like the kind.

filler._doc: How the free building tiles (#) of the map look (WorldView._add_filler): each block is filled with house lots of the first size in lot_sizes ([cols, rows]) that fits, and the tiles left over become yards: each block takes one of yard_themes (vegetable plot, work yard) and each tile one yard of its theme, each at most once per block (the theme's first yard fills the rest). houses / yard_themes / single are scene ids of game/visuals/props/; which one goes where depends only on the tile (the town looks the same every game), weights = repeat an id. mirror flips half of the houses. single = a lone # tile (the plaza's well). Remove this block to go back to one greybox block per tile (props/building.tscn).

hud._doc: HUD presentation: objective_hint_seconds = how long the objective's how-to stays unfolded on the map after the objective changes (then it folds to the title and progress; hovering the panel unfolds it; inside a building it is always shown).

market_demand._doc: docs/ui/mecanicas/mercado_y_libro.md §4.2: the demand indicator's steps (view cuts, not game rules): below each `below` (in order) the step, its word (ui.market.demand.<word>) and its colour token (tools/ui/tokens.json).

notices._doc: H3 / docs/ui/01_hud.md §5: the notices of the player's family pop up in the notices zone (at most popup_max at once; the oldest goes, it stays in the book): urgent until clicked or the book is opened, warning for popup_seconds, done (the keys in done_keys: a goal met) for done_seconds; info only in the book. Severity colours of the notices log.

new_game._doc: H3 new game screen (GDD 4.16): the start offered (data/starts/) and the family colours to pick from (4.10.9; provisional palette from the style bible's base tones).

interior._doc: H2 interior (GDD 4.6.4): zoom, camera offset (from the centre of the HUD's free view, docs/ui/01 §4.6), fade (in+out, seconds), the colours of the station marks (busy, progress, master-touch window) and its blink. The room, its stations and its colours are game/visuals/interiors/<type>.tscn.

palette._doc: H8 identidad visual (GDD 4.10.9): los tonos de la paleta de intercambio por índice (data/family.json visual: los 6 de pelo y 4 de piel del reparto fijo; data/cast.json look: los que saca el reparto generado) [balance]. La ropa principal es el color primario de la familia. Los aplica la figura greybox (game/visuals/greybox/greybox_figure.gd) y el retrato (game/visuals/characters/portrait.tscn); los sprites, cuando respeten los colores clave (8.4, 9.6).

portraits._doc: Población: base portraits (data/cast.json portraits; the pool's assets/art/portraits/index.json and its fallback, game/visuals/visual_paths.gd portrait). fallback: the types tried in order when neither the person's type nor the index's fallback has art for its age band and sex (the greybox after them). greying: how much the hair goes to grey (0..1) by age band; the art does not paint grey hair, the game does (the index's README, point 5).

aged_hair._doc: Hair tones the palette keeps for age (index 5, the white of #d8d0c0; data/cast.json look.hair leaves it out): whoever carries one (a start or map that fixes it, a birth that inherits it, an old game) is drawn with the natural tone given here; the white comes only from greying, by age band (verificación E2).

upgrades._doc: H5 upgrade tree (GDD 4.8): latest_only_branches = branches whose visuals replace each other (only the highest finished level is shown; the rest show every finished level). status colours of the tree panel's cells (owned, in_works, available, blocked). works: the bar over a building under construction on the map (back, fill, text) and the panel's bar. The scaffold itself is the node Works of game/visuals/buildings/<type>.tscn.

social._doc: Social panels (docs/ui/mecanicas/_social.md): relation_bands = [upper bound, word id] of the relation -100..100, in order (relation_band.<id> in i18n).

skip._doc: «Saltar hasta…» (docs/gdd/03b_diversion_y_ritmo.md §3b.5.2, O-D3): the session speed while skipping and the most it runs (days) before stopping by itself.
